system.description:
When striking enemies with a melee attack you can quickly release a jet of Nature Energy from the back of your striking limb like a piston, giving the strike an amplified effect.

On a hit of a melee attack, you can cast this just, increasing the attacks impact, dealing an additional 4d8 force damage and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, being Dazed on a failure.

If you have the Feral Axe or Feral Morningstar instinct, this damage ignores resistance and treats immunity as resistance.

Amplify: By spending 4 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, you activate chakra thrusters on your elbow, moving across the battle field and attempting to drag your target with you. If the affected creature fails their saving throw, they become Grappled by you and you can move up to your movement speed in a direction of your choice, pulling them with you.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and damage by 1d8.
